_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Copyright (c) OpenEdge Labs. Single source for the install guides: scripts/gen-install-docs.ps1 writes docs/install/*.md from it and scripts/test-install.ps1 runs the same steps in clean containers. Commands use $VERSION and $BASE (the release download URL).

platforms.title: Debian 12 (bookworm)
platforms.prerequisites: command -v curl >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl)

platforms.title: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
platforms.prerequisites: command -v curl >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl)

platforms.title: Kali Linux (rolling)
platforms.prerequisites: command -v curl >/dev/null || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl)

platforms.title: Fedora 40
platforms.prerequisites: command -v curl >/dev/null || sudo dnf install -y curl

platforms.title: RHEL 9 and compatible (Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux)
platforms.prerequisites: command -v curl >/dev/null || sudo dnf install -y curl

platforms.title: Alpine Linux 3.20
platforms.prerequisites:
command -v curl >/dev/null || sudo apk add curl
command -v openrc >/dev/null || sudo apk add openrc
platforms.install:
tar -xzf wedge-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/wedge /usr/local/bin/wedge
sudo addgroup -S wedge && sudo adduser -S -D -H -G wedge -s /sbin/nologin wedge
sudo mkdir -p /etc/wedge/conf.d /srv/www
sudo cp x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/examples/www/default/index.html /srv/www/
printf '[server]\nlisten = ["127.0.0.1:8080"]\ndefault_vhost = "default"\n\n[[vhost]]\nname = "default"\nroot = "/srv/www"\n' | sudo tee /etc/wedge/wedge.toml >/dev/null
sudo chown -R root:wedge /etc/wedge && sudo chmod 0750 /etc/wedge && sudo chmod 0640 /etc/wedge/wedge.toml
sudo install -m 0755 x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/openrc/wedge /etc/init.d/wedge
platforms.start: sudo rc-update add wedge default && sudo rc-service wedge start
platforms.remove:
sudo rc-service wedge stop; sudo rc-update del wedge default
sudo rm /etc/init.d/wedge /usr/local/bin/wedge
